content.short: Laminar is a Hyperliquid-native DEX pairing concentrated liquidity with intent-based routing.
content.description: Laminar runs both a concentrated liquidity AMM and classic pools on HyperEVM. The V3 design lets providers place capital in custom price ranges across fee tiers of 0.05, 0.3 and 1 percent, chosen to suit different pair volatilities, and fees can be collected without withdrawing the position. V2 classic pools remain available for providers wanting simple two-sided exposure.
